definitions.gloss: to spare, to devote, to set aside
definitions.explanation: To allocate or devote time, effort, resources, or space for a particular purpose. Often implies carving out something from a limited supply.
To tear or split something apart by pulling. A physical sense that is less common in modern everyday usage but appears in literary contexts.

examples.japanese: ⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{割|さ}いて⟦くれた→くれる：00724_kureru⟧。
⟦{研究|けんきゅう}→研究：01396_kenkyuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{多|おお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{予算|よさん}→予算：03663_yosan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{割|さ}いた。
examples.english: We devoted a large portion of the budget to research.

examples.japanese: ⟦お{忙|いそが}しいところ→お忙しいところ：23577_oisogashiitokoro⟧⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{割|さ}いて⟦いただき→いただく：01326_itadaku⟧⟦ありがとうございます→ありがとうございます：09886_arigatougozaimasu⟧。
examples.english: Thank you for taking time out of your busy schedule.
I tore the cloth apart by hand.

examples.japanese: ⟦{二人|ふたり}→二人：00622_futari⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{仲|なか}→仲：09513_naka⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{割|さ}くこと⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦できない→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: You cannot tear those two apart.

examples.japanese: ⟦{群衆|ぐんしゅう}→群衆：14930_gunshuu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{割|さ}いて⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{進|すす}んだ→進む：01225_susumu⟧。
examples.english: I pushed through the crowd and moved forward.

notes:
Godan verb (く row: {割|さ}く → {割|さ}かない → {割|さ}いて). Not to be confused with the homophone ⟦{裂|さ}く→裂く：02107_saku⟧, which focuses on tearing/splitting and is written with a different kanji.

Sense 1 is much more common in modern usage. The pattern ～⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{割|さ}く is typically used with ⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧, ⟦{人手|ひとで}→人手：25438_hitode⟧, ⟦{予算|よさん}→予算：03663_yosan⟧, or {紙面|しめん} (page space).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{割|さ}く — to spare time
- ⟦{人手|ひとで}→人手：25438_hitode⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{割|さ}く — to allocate personnel
- ⟦ページ→ページ：02961_peeji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{割|さ}く — to devote pages/space to
- ⟦{労力|ろうりょく}→労力：22670_rouryoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{割|さ}く — to devote effort
